firstPlayerRule: The most experienced paleontologist or surfer starts and places the Surfosaurus MAX marker on their surfboard.
clarifications: Play proceeds clockwise. In each later round, the player to the previous starter's left receives the marker and starts.
internalEvidence: The publisher's Surfosaurus MAX page links this two-page English PDF. PDF page 1 names the most experienced paleontologist/surfer, assigns the first-player marker, and states clockwise play. PDF page 2 passes the marker left in later rounds.
